summary: This bill expands the Department of Veterans Affairs' Solid Start program to include outreach to active duty service members before they separate, providing them with information on healthcare, local VA facilities, and disability claim assistance, and coordinating with the Department of Defense on suicide prevention resources.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Solid Start program to improve outreach to members of the Armed Forces before their separation, coordinating efforts with the Department of Defense and collecting information on DoD suicide prevention policies. While it involves military personnel and coordination with the DoD, its primary focus is on veterans' transition support rather than military spending or defense policy itself.
